about.title: Business software that speaks your language.
about.lead: HelloKhata was started in Bangladesh with a simple belief: managing a business shouldn't require learning a foreign language — technical or otherwise.
story: Walk down any street in Bangladesh and you'll see businesses run with remarkable skill — often with nothing more than a ledger, a calculator and an excellent memory.
Most business software was not made for them. It's built around unfamiliar terms, complicated menus and the assumption that everyone wants to work in English.
HelloKhata starts from the other side: from how business owners already talk about their work. Ask in your own words, record a sale by speaking, and see your business clearly.
about.mission: To make it easy for every business owner to understand their business and make better-informed decisions — in their own language.

articles.q: What do I need to start using HelloKhata?
articles.a: A smartphone or computer with internet access, your business name and the list of products you sell. You can add products gradually — you don't need everything on day one.

articles.q: Can I use HelloKhata in Bangla?
articles.a: Yes. HelloKhata is designed for Bangla and English, and you can switch languages at any time.

articles.q: Which types of businesses can use it?
articles.a: Grocery and retail shops, pharmacies, super shops, online sellers, F-commerce sellers and other businesses that buy, sell and keep accounts. Some solution modules are still planned — each Solutions page shows the current status.

articles.q: Can I sell online with my own store?
articles.a: HelloKhata Online Store is designed to let sellers build a branded storefront connected to their products and orders. Check the Online Store page for the current status of each capability.

articles.q: Can HelloKhata reply to my Facebook messages?
articles.a: HelloKhata Social Commerce is designed to bring Page messages into a shared inbox with AI-assisted replies, but only for Pages and accounts you connect and authorise. It cannot read private Facebook Group posts. See the F-Commerce page for the current status of each channel.

articles.q: How do I record a sale on due?
articles.a: When making a bill, choose the customer and select due as the payment method, fully or partly. Their balance updates automatically.

articles.q: Can I record a sale by speaking?
articles.a: The voice assistant is designed to help you record and ask about business activity by speaking. Availability may depend on your plan.
Stock goes down with every sale and up with every purchase you record. You can also adjust stock manually after a count.

articles.q: How do I include transport costs in a purchase?
articles.a: When recording a purchase, add transport, labour or other costs. They're included in the cost per unit of the goods.

articles.q: Where do the assistant's answers come from?
articles.a: From the business records in your account that you're authorised to access. If the information isn't recorded, the assistant can't know it.

articles.q: Does the assistant listen all the time?
articles.a: No. It only listens when you choose to ask a question.

articles.q: Who can see my business information?
articles.a: People you authorise on your account. Details about data handling will be set out in our Privacy Policy.
Call us on +880 1734-114388, message us on WhatsApp at +880 1922-557436, email contact@hellokhata.com, or use the contact page. Tell us your business type and question, and we'll get back to you.

items.q: How does HelloKhata help with my shop's accounts?
items.a: You can record your shop's daily accounts — sales, stock, purchases, expenses and customer dues — in one app, and see them by day, week or month when you need to.

items.q: Can I record sales from my mobile?
items.a: Yes. HelloKhata is designed for mobile use — pick a product, enter the quantity and the sale is recorded.

items.q: Can I keep track of stock and purchases?
items.a: Yes. Stock goes down with sales and up when you record a purchase. You can also add transport or labour costs to a purchase.
Yes. Sales on due are recorded against the customer, and payments can be recorded when they pay. You can check who owes what at any time.

items.q: Can I ask about my business by speaking Bangla?
items.a: HelloKhata's assistant is designed to answer questions in Bangla from the records in your account. If something isn't recorded, the assistant can't know it.

items.q: How do I start using HelloKhata?
items.a: Tap “Start using the app” and enter your business type and details. If you need help, write to us from the contact page.

items.q: What can HelloKhata do for my pharmacy?
items.a: HelloKhata helps you record medicine sales, manage stock with batch and expiry information, record purchases and supplier balances, keep track of expenses and customer dues, and view reports — in one place. Prescription OCR helps read handwritten prescriptions to reduce manual entry.

Prescription OCR is designed to help read handwritten prescription details such as medicine name, strength and instructions. It is an assistive tool: results are shown for a person to review and correct.

items.q: Does prescription OCR always identify medicines correctly?
items.a: No. Recognition depends on how readable the prescription is and on the system's capabilities. Unclear fields are flagged, and important details — medicine names, strengths and instructions — must be reviewed by a qualified person before use.

items.q: Can I manage medicine inventory and expiry information?
items.a: Yes. You can see stock by medicine with batch and expiry information, and find items that are running low or approaching expiry. Each capability shows its current status on this page.

items.q: Can I record purchases and supplier payments?
items.a: Yes. Record purchases with items, quantities and costs, including transport or labour where needed, and keep track of what you've paid and still owe each supplier.

items.q: Can I track sales and business expenses?
items.a: Yes. Sales are recorded with payment details, and expenses such as rent, bills and salaries can be recorded by category.

items.q: Can I view pharmacy sales reports?
items.a: Yes. Reports show sales, costs, expenses and profit by period, along with inventory value and outstanding balances. Profit figures depend on purchase costs and expenses being recorded.

items.q: How can I get started with HelloKhata?
items.a: Select Get Started and enter your business details. If you'd like help choosing the right setup, contact our team.

final.title: Bring your pharmacy operations together.
final.lead: Manage everyday pharmacy work with clearer records, organised stock, and intelligent tools designed to make business management easier.
